ModMetaData.name: Hospital (Fork)
ModMetaData.author: Adamas, Niejeden
ModMetaData.description:
Run a hospital: if you have this mod enabled (and settings allow you to receive patients) and you have plenty of medical beds, patients will knock on your door asking for help with their disease, wounds or a surgery.
Fork of Hospital by Adamas, maintained by mgrTDziedzic (Niejeden). Published with permission of Adamas. Replaces the original Hospital - do not run both.
Original: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2992224079 Source (GPLv3): https://github.com/mgrTDziedzic/Hospital-Fork
